title: Her brief marriage to Harlan O. Smith of the Navy
summary: Humes reluctantly tells of marrying Harlan Smith, a Navy man, in Reno. He wrote every day, she tired of writing back, and the marriage faded when his ship left.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family

blocks.x: Well, Helen you know what, this is just about the time that you got married, you know?
